companyProfile.title: Company Profile
companyProfile.helpBanner: Here you can enter and edit your company's master data. This is the data that is used in the handbook. This is the same data we use when we need to contact your company. This data is also used on the invoices we send.

companyProfile.senderNameNote: Default is your business name. Max 30 characters.
